title: Iran fires missiles at Kuwait and Bahrain, U.S. strikes Iran facility
summary: The U.S. military said that Iran fired missiles at Kuwait and Bahrain that failed or were shot down, and that the U.S. launched strikes on an Iranian facility in response.
contentText:
Kuwait briefly shut the country's main airport after Iranian drones heavily damaged it and killed one person, the latest in a series of attacks by Iran and the U.S. that have tested a fragile truce.

(Image credit: Amirhosein Khorgooi)
